Hello to front line,
The lounge attendant sent an update on rest areas

Thank you for the careful notes already shared with the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. I am recording the report in a warm and orderly manner so the file remains clear for the next review. The cabin team has confirmed steady attention to animal comfort during the journey, and the welcome team has continued to prepare passengers with courtesy before boarding. Please continue to send any observations in plain language, especially when a traveler is waiting with a pet or when a crate needs closer attention.

For the missed connection item, please place <<FACT F116>> in the record exactly as provided. If the traveler raises a concern at the counter, keep the exchange calm, note the facts carefully, and avoid adding assumptions. If the customer service desk receives a related follow-up, send it through the usual channel so the record can be matched without delay. Clear notes help preserve trust and reduce confusion for everyone involved.

For the lost crate item, please place <<FACT F112>> in the record exactly as provided. If there is supporting paperwork from the cabin team or the welcome team, attach it with a brief note about condition, handling, and where the item was last confirmed. Marcus Costa and Mei Lee may be referenced in the case file if they are already part of the interaction, and Willow may be mentioned if the pet is relevant to the report. I appreciate prompt, respectful communication from each colleague, as it supports both the travelers and the animals in our care. Please keep sending updates in the same steady manner, and thank you for the support shown on the floor today.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
